fishing: WHEN: Charlotte Harbor snook season opened Oct 1 (slot 28-33, 1/day) through Nov 30; gag closed Sep 30. Afternoon storms today — pass and beach early. PASSES-BEACH: Stump Pass islands holding reds and snook; snook sliding into the ICW (Fishin Franks 9/18). LEMON BAY: smaller black drum and big redfish under docks, pompano in the pass, trout and juvenile gags on the flats (9/25); school reds Miserable Mile to Tom Adams. NEARSHORE: reefs mostly little stuff plus a few snook; mangrove, lane, and yellowtail from about 80 ft; red grouper 100-150 ft. Baits: live shrimp, white bait, pinfish, cut bait.
redtide: FWC Sep 25: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Charlotte/Lee and offshore Monroe); not observed in Sarasota. No fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next report Oct 2.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD. Manasota Key enterococci 10 on 9/28; Englewood Beach 10 CFU. No advisory.
fpl: Evening tracker: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota ~149 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
